Maria L: FYI I opened a PR to fold kv-prefetch tips into the Optimize toolkit page and add a tiny JS snippet showing batching + 4-bit quant for short sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/358

Devin P: Noted. The snippet uses the old client factory API; we'll need to switch to newClient({requestOptions: ...}). I'll hold a patch until we confirm numbers.

Sasha M: I'll run quick microbenchmarks on the infra later today. Question: should the docs recommend lowering max_batch and the aggregation window for short sequences (<32 tokens)? Also want to confirm q4_0 vs q4_K guidance re: latency vs density.

Maria L: Proposed copy: "For latency-sensitive short requests (<=32 tokens): use small batches (max_batch 1-4) and q4_0 for lowest latency. For throughput workloads, increase batch size and prefer q4_K for denser utilization." Want to include p50/p95 numbers if possible.

Kyle R: I can bench on T4 and A10 tonight. I'll post commands, raw latency CSVs, and a couple of flamegraphs. Also fixed two broken anchors in the migration guide and will open a tiny PR for that.

Devin P: Once Kyle posts results I'll update the JS snippet and normalize the code style. Also agree we should add a short "when to use" blurb under the quant profile table and a note in batching about cache-hit vs batch-size tradeoffs.

Sasha M: Also recommend adding a reproducibility snippet (simple curl + python loop) so users can try the knobs locally. I'll draft it after the bench run.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs require >=1 eng + 1 docs reviewer. Label applied: needs-eng-review.

Maria L: Action items recap: (1) Kyle: bench logs + link-fix PR, (2) Sasha: validate latency/throughput guidance and suggest defaults for max_batch/agg_window, (3) Devin: patch SDK snippet after benches. I'll rebase and request final review after these land. Thanks everyone :rocket:
